# Synology QuickConnect
> Synology QuickConnect lets users securely access a Synology NAS remotely from any device without manual port forwarding.

QuickConnect is Synology’s remote access service for DSM, mobile apps, and browser-based NAS access. It is commonly used alongside DSM, Synology Account, and package-specific remote access workflows.

## Product Overview
- [QuickConnect](https://quickconnect.to/): Main QuickConnect entry point for remote Synology NAS access.
- [Synology](https://www.synology.com/): Synology homepage for NAS products, software, and services.
- [DSM](https://www.synology.com/dsm): Overview of DiskStation Manager, Synology’s NAS operating system.
- [Synology Account](https://account.synology.com/): Account portal used for Synology services and identity management.

## Quick Start and Setup
- [How do I sign in to DSM with QuickConnect?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/How_to_login_to_DSM_with_QuickConnect): Steps for accessing DSM remotely using a QuickConnect ID.
- [How do I enable QuickConnect?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/How_to_enable_QuickConnect): Instructions for turning on QuickConnect in DSM.
- [How can I register for a Synology Account?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/How_to_register_for_a_Synology_Account): Guide to creating the account required for QuickConnect services.
- [How do I customize my QuickConnect ID?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/How_to_customize_QuickConnect_ID): Explains changing and managing a NAS QuickConnect identifier.

## DSM Remote Access
- [External Access](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/help/DSM/AdminCenter/connection_quickconnect): DSM Help page covering QuickConnect and external access settings.
- [Sign in to DSM via Web Browser](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/How_to_login_to_DSM_with_QuickConnect): Browser-based DSM login using QuickConnect.
- [Set up router configuration for DSM](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/What_network_ports_are_used_by_Synology_services): Reference for ports used by DSM and Synology services.
- [Troubleshoot connection issues in DSM](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/What_can_I_do_if_I_cannot_connect_to_my_Synology_NAS_via_QuickConnect): Troubleshooting steps for failed QuickConnect access.

## Security and Networking
- [What network ports are used by Synology services?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/What_network_ports_are_used_by_Synology_services): Port reference for DSM, packages, and remote connectivity.
- [What can I do if I cannot connect to my Synology NAS via QuickConnect?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/What_can_I_do_if_I_cannot_connect_to_my_Synology_NAS_via_QuickConnect): Diagnostic guidance for QuickConnect failures.
- [How does QuickConnect work?](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/tutorial/QuickConnect_white_paper): Technical explanation of relay and direct connection behavior.
- [Security Advisor](https://kb.synology.com/en-us/DSM/help/DSM/SecurityScan/securityscan_desc): DSM Help page for checking NAS security posture.

## Mobile and Client Apps
- [DS file](https://www.synology.com/dsm/feature/file_sharing): File access features commonly used with QuickConnect-enabled NAS systems.
- [Synology Drive](https://www.synology.com/dsm/feature/drive): File sync and collaboration service accessible remotely.
- [Synology Photos](https://www.synology.com/dsm/feature/photos): Photo management and sharing service for remote access.
- [DS cam](https://www.synology.com/surveillance): Surveillance access product often used with QuickConnect.
- [Synology mobile applications](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages): Package and app ecosystem related to remote NAS access.

## Package and Service Access
- [Synology Drive Server](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages/SynologyDrive): Drive package for file sync, sharing, and remote collaboration.
- [Synology Photos](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages/SynologyPhotos): Photos package for browsing and sharing media remotely.
- [Audio Station](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages/AudioStation): Audio streaming package accessible through Synology remote services.
- [Video Station](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages/VideoStation): Video library package for remote media access.
- [Surveillance Station](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/packages/SurveillanceStation): Video surveillance package with remote monitoring support.
